The plate is roughly 26 cm across, and the squash covers only a small part of it.

The yellow squash pieces form a cluster about 9 cm by 8 cm, one layer thick at about 1.5 cm. I estimate that at roughly 80 g.

The separate pieces on the left are a dark green zucchini or squash wedge and a yellow piece. Together they come to about 25 g.

There is a slight sheen that suggests a little oil or seasoning, but too little to count as a separate item.
